text: An intense vegetal smell arises from the dead plant as you cut through it.  It's not entirely unpleasant.
The monster's sap is sticky and somewhat greenish.
The monster lacks muscles or anything else that would obviously allow it to move around.

The creature's vascular system is highly advanced, the xylem forming a complex network of bulbs and vessels that do much more than just handle circulation.  In life, it used this to move by hydraulic locomotion.

A sac inside the creature turns out to be a chamber for digestion.  Sweet-smelling enzymes mingle with the odor of death, and bits of burnt hair from some unfortunate victim still cling to the inner walls.
The monster's roots are well developed, branching out into a multitude of tendrils that suggest it still takes nutrients from the soil despite its carnivorous diet.
